root_causes: Raw result count used for early harvest before query evidence filtering.
SearX chain shared a single abort budget across instances.
Rescue tested raw-empty, not evidence-empty; transient empty/degraded responses cached.
Late canceled providers wrote health after router return; uncooperative providers could outlive disabled soft deadline.

test.red: Three scheduling failures reproduced; SearX pre-aborted injected fixture hang fixed before green; red process explicitly killed.

measurement.scope: Separate development SearchCore process, isolated cache, actual public network; not paired same-time A/B and not Web adoption.
measurement.raw: Bing returned 5 broad SQLite pages rejected by unchanged gate; Keenable 5672ms/3 accepted; HN 5981ms/4 accepted; SearX 16494ms/429 after connect timeout.
measurement.after: SQLite WAL concurrency:5 candidates/10033ms including official wal.html; Zed DeltaDB:5 candidates/1897ms including zed.dev/deltadb. Mixed domain routing still selects specialty sources beyond default config.engines; explicit opts.engines is provider allowlist.
limitations: Public availability changes; unpaired samples cannot quantify guaranteed improvement.
Old/draft pages can rank first; candidate evidence is not version correctness.
Recovery can increase quality-empty latency to10s; endpoint rate limits remain.
Existing DDG throttle/backoff and external X chain remain outside this milestone.
